items.q: Do I need to upload images to a server?
items.a: No. All AI background removal runs entirely in your browser via ONNX Runtime Web - your images never leave your device and are never uploaded to any server, protecting your privacy.

items.q: Which image formats are supported? How fast is it?
items.a: JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, GIF and SVG are supported. Pro model takes about 4s/image, Portrait about 1.5s/image, Mini about 1s/image. Output is a transparent-background PNG at full resolution.

items.q: How large can images be? Any batch limits?
items.a: The Pro model supports up to 16000×16000 pixels; Mini and Portrait support up to 2048×2048. Batch processing has no hard limits, but we recommend under 100 images or 500MB at once for smooth performance.
Yes, 100% free. No registration, no login, no hidden fees. All features - batch processing, HD downloads, multiple AI models - are available without limits.

items.q: Which AI models are used? What's the difference?
items.a: Three models: Pro (BRIA RMBG v1.4, 42MB, best quality including semi-transparent objects), Portrait (MODNet, 25MB, optimized for people), Mini (U²-Net, 4.4MB, lightweight and fast). You can also run all models and compare.

items.q: Can I use it on mobile or tablet?
items.a: Yes. The tool is fully responsive and works in mobile and tablet browsers with no app installation. Touch drag-and-drop and paste are supported.

items.q: How does it compare to tools like remove.bg?
items.a: Our Pro model (BRIA RMBG) achieves results close to commercial tools in most scenarios, especially for people, products and animals. As a free, fully local tool, it has a clear advantage in privacy and value.

tech.title: Technical Details
tech.p1: This tool runs AI models directly in your browser with {eng}, so all inference happens locally with no server involvement. Three architectures are used: {bria} (general), {modnet} (portraits) and {u2net} (lightweight & fast).
tech.p2: With {gpu} or {wasm} hardware acceleration, inference reaches 1-4 seconds per image. Models are cached in IndexedDB, so subsequent loads need no re-download.
tech.p3: According to a 2024 Princeton study (Aggarwal et al.), in-browser AI inference offers significant advantages in privacy and response speed over cloud solutions - your data never leaves the device, and latency depends only on local hardware.
